vars.lines: (c => { const r = D.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(c); const ys = new Set([...r.getClientRects()].filter(x => x.width > 0).map(x => Math.round(x.top))); return ys.size; })

steps.eval: (() => { const t = ${tbl}; const L = ${lines}; const cells = [...t.querySelectorAll('th, td')]; const shortCells = cells.filter(c => { const s = c.textContent.trim(); return s && s.length <= 24 && !/\s/.test(s); }); const wrapped = shortCells.filter(c => L(c) > 1).map(c => c.textContent.trim()); const longWrapped = cells.filter(c => /\s/.test(c.textContent.trim()) && L(c) > 1).map(c => c.textContent.trim()); return JSON.stringify({previewWidth: W.innerWidth, tableClient: t.clientWidth, tableScroll: t.scrollWidth, overflowAttr: t.getAttribute('data-sphinx-table-overflow'), shortCells: shortCells.length, shortMarked: t.querySelectorAll('[data-sphinx-short-cell="true"]').length, shortWrapped: wrapped, multiWordWrapped: longWrapped, bg: getComputedStyle(t).backgroundImage.slice(0, 80)}); })()

steps.expr: (() => { const t = ${tbl}; const L = ${lines}; return [...t.querySelectorAll('th, td')].filter(c => { const s = c.textContent.trim(); return s && s.length <= 24 && !/\s/.test(s) && L(c) > 1; }).length; })()
